headline: Quantum Resources: From Circuits to Networks
summary: Today's selection explores novel uses of quantum resources across distinct structural regimes. Contributions span gate-optimal error correction decoders, quantum-native network architectures, and continuous symmetry dualities in 1D lattice models.

themes.title: Quantum Information & Architecture
themes.body: Studies tackle foundational quantum communication and error correction, from optimizing decoder gates in repetition-code process tomography to harnessing entanglement and superpositions directly for network routing and addressing.

themes.title: Many-Body Quantum Dualities
themes.body: Mathematical physics advances provide a general blueprint via Schur-Weyl duality to gauge continuous Lie symmetries in 1D quantum lattice systems using matrix product operator intertwiners.
